# SOP-P1-L4-02 Product changeover - Heat Treat line

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1, line P1-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-CN01, EQ-P1-L4-HP02, EQ-P1-L4-HT03

Preconditions
1. Only trained operators authorized for P1-L4 are to perform this procedure.
2. Verify maintenance clearance is not active on EQ-P1-L4-CN01, EQ-P1-L4-HP02, EQ-P1-L4-HT03.
3. Confirm required tooling and parts are staged per SOP-P1-L4-05.
4. Review applicable control plans and quality checkpoints in QS-PROC-05 and maintenance history in MM-P1-L4-HT03.

PPE
1. Safety glasses.
2. Heat-resistant gloves for handling hot parts from EQ-P1-L4-HT03.
3. Hearing protection while operating EQ-P1-L4-HP02.

Procedure
1. Stop line flow and open lockout per plant lockout rules. Verify zero energy state on EQ-P1-L4-CN01 before accessing machine.
2. Drain and isolate fluids from EQ-P1-L4-HP02 before removing headers. Dispose fluids per MM-P1-L4-HT03.
3. On EQ-P1-L4-CN01, confirm spindle warm-up time for Heat Treat CNC turning center #1 (EQ-P1-L4-CN01) is 15 minutes. Start warm-up sequence and do not load parts until complete.
4. Replace CNC tooling and fixtures per job traveler. Verify clamping and clearance against part drawing referenced in SOP-P1-L4-05.
5. For spindle lubrication on EQ-P1-L4-CN01, use lubricant part number for Heat Treat CNC turning center #1 (EQ-P1-L4-CN01) is CFW-LUB-477. Apply per lubrication point chart and verify quantity visually.
6. Power up EQ-P1-L4-HT03 and confirm furnace control setpoints match job packet. Follow QS-PROC-05 for first-part inspection criteria.
7. Run an initial dry cycle and inspect fixtures, coolant flow, and chip evacuation on EQ-P1-L4-HP02 and EQ-P1-L4-CN01.
8. Produce first-piece sample and document dimensional checks. If out of tolerance, stop and escalate per QS-PROC-05.

Sign-off
Operator name: ______________________  
Operator signature: __________________  
Supervisor name: ____________________  
Supervisor signature: ________________  

Related documents: MM-P1-L4-HT03, QS-PROC-05, SOP-P1-L4-05
